Item Class: Relics
Rarity: Unique
The Changing Seasons
Seal Relic
--------
Item Level: 70
--------
Your Honour is restored by 25% when you defeat a Boss
Rooms with Honour Shrines have an additional Shrine
--------
Each season brings its own trials.
--------
Place this item on any Relic Altar at the start of a Trial of the Sekhemas to apply its effects.
